landing.title: Fun, creative coloring every day!
landing.subtitle: Hundreds of cute pictures, a weekly creative arena, rare picture cards to collect and storybooks made by your child.

creative.title: Two coloring modes
creative.text: Paint-by-number to learn colors, or Free Coloring to create anything.

arena.title: Creative Arena
arena.text: Color alongside 10 kids with fair, automatic scoring.

gacha.title: Collect rare cards
gacha.text: Win prizes to open S/A/B/C cards — no real money involved.

together.title: Color together
together.text: Invite friends to color one picture in real time.

storybook.title: Make a storybook
storybook.text: Turn pictures into a flip-page book and download a PDF.

safe.title: Safe for kids
safe.text: Parents verify with a one-time code; friends and rooms use private codes only.

auth.registerSubtitle: Create an account — no Gmail needed.
auth.registeredOk: You're signed up! Please log in.
auth.passwordHint: At least 6 characters with letters and numbers.
auth.guardianHint: Only used to recover the password. We'll send a one-time code for a parent to confirm.
auth.devOtp: Test environment (SMS/Email not configured): your code is {{code}}

forgotStep.contact: Enter the parent phone or email used when signing up.
forgotStep.code: If the details are correct, a code was sent to {{to}}.
forgotStep.reset: Pick the account and set a new password.

google.or: Or, for users aged 13 and over
google.age: I confirm I am at least 13 years old to use a Google account.
google.ageRequired: Please confirm you are 13 or older first.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.subtitle: Pick a display name and an avatar.
welcome.nicknameHint: Don't use your full real name, phone number or address.

profile.avatarFrameHint: Avatar frames unlock when you rank up in the Arena.

select.themesHint: What would you like to color today?

mode.pick: How would you like to color?

template.title: Paint by number
template.text: A sample picture and numbers for every area.

free.title: Free coloring
free.text: Pick any colors you like — counts in the Arena.

coloring.clearText: All colors, strokes and stickers will be removed. You can press Undo to get them back.

tools.pickSticker: Pick a sticker, then tap the picture

reveal.title: Your picture came to life!
reveal.subtitle: It has been saved to your History.

history.title: Coloring history
history.retention: Finished pictures are kept forever. Unfinished ones are deleted after 30 days without opening (you'll be warned first).
history.frameHint: The frame is added around the picture when downloading or printing.
history.buyFrames: Buy more frames in the Shop →

plans.title: Choose a plan
plans.subtitle: Upgrade to color more pictures every day.
plans.note: Pay with MoMo or PayPal. Prices include tax. The Yearly plan costs ~15% less than 12 monthly payments.
plans.mockNotice: The payment gateway is not configured on this server. This is a TEST transaction; no real money is charged.

upgrade.title: Out of pictures for now!
upgrade.freeUsed: The Free plan includes 1 picture per day. Come back tomorrow, or ask a parent to upgrade.
upgrade.monthUsed: You've used all 100 pictures this month. Upgrade to Yearly for unlimited coloring.

missions.title: Missions & achievements
missions.maxed: You've finished all 20 levels! New missions are coming soon.
missions.hint: Each mission gives Ruby right away. Finish all 3 to reach the next level.
missions.rankHint: Place in the Arena top 3 to earn Rank points. Rank points never go down.

popup.newFrame: You got a new avatar frame.

arena.title: Creative Arena
arena.subtitle: Up to {{size}} kids per room color the same picture in Free mode for {{minutes}} minutes.
arena.randomHint: We match you with kids at a similar level.
arena.privateHint: Create a room and send the code to friends (friends only).
arena.noLeaders: No leaders yet this week — be the first!
arena.friendsOnly: Only the host's friends can join.
arena.needMore: At least {{n}} players are needed to start.

rubric.coverageHint: Fill everything, leave no big blank areas.
rubric.accuracyHint: Brush strokes stay inside the lines. Fill never counts as messy.
rubric.harmonyHint: Colors go well together with a clear accent.
rubric.creativityHint: The more unique compared to the room, the better.
rubric.timeHint: Finishing early and still looking great earns a bonus.

gacha.title: Open picture cards
gacha.how: Every {{cost}} Gacha points = 1 pull. Earn Gacha points by placing top 3 in the Arena. Pulling never lowers your rank.
gacha.empty: No cards yet. Join the Arena to earn Gacha points!

shop.title: Shop
shop.hint: Spend Ruby from missions on brush skins and frames.
shop.avatarFramesHint: Not for sale — unlocked by ranking up in the Arena.

friends.title: Friends
friends.codeHint: Only share this code with people you know.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Swap friend codes with your friends!

trade.title: Gift & swap cards
trade.noCards: You have no cards to give yet.
trade.friendNoCards: Your friend has no cards yet.
trade.twoWay: Your friend must also agree for it to go through.
trade.confirmAcceptExchange: {{name}} wants to swap “{{theirs}}” for your “{{mine}}”. Accept?

together.title: Color together
together.subtitle: 2–4 kids color one picture and see each other's colors instantly.
together.createHint: Pick a picture, then send the room code to friends.
together.joinHint: Enter the room code a friend sent you.
together.safety: Rooms can only be joined with a private code — there is no public room list. Only share codes with people you know.
together.saved: {{name}} saved the picture to everyone's History!

storybook.title: My storybooks
storybook.subtitle: Turn Free coloring pictures into a flip-page book.
storybook.titlePlaceholder: e.g. The Adventures of Chubby Cat
storybook.addHint: Pick pictures below to add pages.
storybook.caption: Caption
storybook.captionPlaceholder: Write a line or caption for this page…
storybook.pickHint: Only Free coloring pictures can go into a storybook.
storybook.noArtworks: No finished Free coloring pictures yet.
storybook.needTwo: At least 2 pages are needed to finish.

notifications.rank_up: You ranked up! New avatar frame and {{ruby}} Ruby.
notifications.draft_expiring: Unfinished picture “{{name}}” will be deleted on {{date}} unless you open it.

errors.server_error: Something went wrong, please try again.

errors.invalid_username: Usernames use letters, numbers, _ or dot (4–20 characters).
errors.invalid_phone: That phone number isn't valid (10 digits starting with 0).
errors.otp_expired: The code expired, request a new one.
errors.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong tries, request a new code.
errors.otp_too_frequent: A code was just sent, wait a minute.
errors.age_confirmation_required: Please confirm you are 13 or older.
errors.nickname_required: Please set a display name first.
errors.nickname_private_info: Display names can't contain phone numbers or emails.
errors.quota_exceeded: You're out of pictures for now.
errors.not_enough_ruby: Not enough Ruby. Do more missions!
errors.friend_code_not_found: No one has that friend code.
errors.request_already_sent: Request already sent — wait for them to accept.
errors.card_in_trade: This card is in another offer.
errors.trade_invalid: This offer is no longer valid.
errors.invalid_page_artwork: Only finished Free coloring pictures can be used.
errors.arena_closed: The Arena is closed now, come back during open hours.
errors.empty: The picture is still empty — color some more!
